integrity: All-dimensional proof by spectral inequality and equality-case Boolean Fourier rigidity. Executed self-contained finite checkers are supplemental, not substitutes for proof. Scientific novelty has not been independently confirmed.
scientific_limitations: The rigorous classification applies to binary hypercubes in dimensions at least three; dimension two is treated separately. Finite checkers cover dimensions two through five only. The 1990 foundational article and full 2013 journal article could not be fully inspected; unindexed equivalent statements remain an originality risk. Previously known numerical bounds are credited to earlier work.
title: Rigidity of maximum induced matchings and optimal strong edge colorings of hypercubes
